optimizedDescription.value: Storage ports and fs adapter manage change, draft, archive, cache, manifest, lock, and artifact-status persistence.

optimizedContext.value:
# Storage
## Rules
- Change directories: `YYYYMMDD-HHmmss-<name>` from `createdAt`; prefix filesystem-only, resolve glob `*-<name>`. `list()` ascending `createdAt`; fs active index `{configPath}/tmp/fs-cache/changes/`.
- Derive artifact status at load; manifest stores only `validatedHash`: `__skipped__` → skipped; absent → missing; `preHashCleanup` then SHA-256 match → complete; otherwise in-progress. Skip drift when `artifactTypes.length === 0`.
- `effectiveStatus`: complete hash becomes in-progress if any recursive `requires` not complete/skipped; skipped optional satisfies. `markComplete`/`markSkipped` (`__skipped__`) only validate/skip use cases.
- `storage.archive.pattern`: `{{year}}`, `{{month}}`, `{{day}}`, `{{change.name}}`, `{{change.archivedName}}`; default latter. Reject `{{change.scope}}`/`{{change.workspace}}` via `UnsupportedPatternError`; year 4 digits, month/day padded.
- Archive index only `{configPath}/tmp/fs-cache/archive/`: `.specd-index.jsonl` `{ entry, sourceMtime?, sourceFiles? }`, `.specd-index-meta.json` `{ totalCount, generatedAt, isInvalidated }`. `reindex()` rebuilds, migrates/forgets legacy root indexes; orphan cleanup only rebuild. `get` may scan; routine reads never require root JSONL.
- Archive root `.gitignore` ignores `.staging`, never obsolete index lines. Named factories choose adapter; VCS/null-VCS internal.
- Per core:change-manifest atomic temp+rename; reject root escapes/untracked paths; staged commit preferred multi-update archive. Change locks `{configPath}/tmp/change-locks`.
- Fs cache layout `{configPath}/tmp/fs-cache/{archive,changes,drafts,discarded,specs/<workspace>,validate-specs/<workspace>}/`; access only `FsChangeIndexCache`/`FsSpecIndexCache`; `include*` projection only. Validation cache adds `schemaFingerprint`, `engineVersion`; rows `{ entry, stamps, cacheFingerprint }`; hosts no reindex API.
- First use/init creates idempotent `{configPath}/tmp/.gitignore` with `*` and `!.gitignore`.
## Constraints
- Atomic manifest writes; fs-cache forward-slash paths across OS.
- Cache directory runtime-only; never VCS commit.
